text_block_list.text:
A Muse...
An Umamusume who undergoes rigorous
auditions 
to become a fashion model for racing
silks.

Gran Alegria was lending a hand at this
meetup 
between the Muse and her fans—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
'Play with Muse Booth' is a one-hour
wait! 
Okay, everyone, no pushing~~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Let's dive right in and play the 
"Bouquet Toss Challenge" with us Muses!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whoever catches the tossed bouquet wins! 
Curren and the others are joining in too,
so good luck♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready? Here it comes! 
Bouquet toss, incoming~!

text_block_list.name: The fans
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhh!! All right! 
I got it~~~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, congratulations! 
Those flowers are a gift for you♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~, Muse is just so cute! 
I wanna wear an outfit like that too~♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! All the fans look so happy, too!
That's a million miles of pure joy!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey,
I wanna see the Umamusume do it with each
other too! 
Give the bouquet toss challenge a shot~!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, a head-to-head showdown with Muse?! 
Us?! 
N-No way... that's a bit...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. 
I really look up to those two, 
so that's why... you know...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—Got it!! 
I'm taking on the bouquet toss challenge!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?! G-Gran?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—So with that said, race against me!
Please, Curren-senpai, Flower-san!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I won't go easy even on a mile! 
I'm going all-out for the bouquet!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, Curren plans to do just that. 
I'm gonna show everyone how to win cutely♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
M-Me too. 
I'll do my best to make it a great race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Alright then,
here comes the bouquet! ...Catch!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: All right...! The start dash went great!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: We've got this... It's in the bag---!!

text_block_list.name: Curren & Flower
text_block_list.text: Teyaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Wait...?!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's so cooool!! 
Ms. Muse, you're super-duper fast!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...I lost. And I was so sure I had it,
too. 
Why...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Is there some secret to being a Muse?! 
Like special training exclusive to
Muses...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
N-No, nothing like that, really... 
If anything, I'm still sorely lacking 
as a Muse.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So that someday I could truly be proud. 
I just didn't want to lose...
That was the only thing on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You're right!
It's not like the title of Muse is what
makes Curren and everyone 
shine so cutely♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Becoming so cute and strong that titles pale
in comparison. 
I guess those feelings really reached
them☆

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So this is... the Muse...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Muse really is cute after all. 
My heart totally fluttered when she caught
the bouquet!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! But that's not all!
She's got conviction and pride,
and she's strong!
And then, and then—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, calm down for a second! 
Were you always such a big Muse fan?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, a 100-mile-class wall? 
The closest thing to the strongest that I've
dreamed of!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Being a Muse is amazing! Truly amazing! 
Ahahahahaha!!
